title: MNBL generation job progress event
description: One event of a generation job (src/MNBL.ProceduralWorld/Generation/ProgressEvents.cs, docs/generation-job.md). Each job's events carry its jobId and a sequence that starts at 0 and increases by one per event; a consumer follows one job and drops any event of another job or not newer than the last it accepted. completed and total appear only when the work has a known size (the source generation's attempts). messageCode is a stable lower_snake code the UI localises; the error is structured (an MMR-47 category, a diagnostic code, retryable), its detail stays in the job's diagnostics. Events are also written to the job's events.jsonl; phase timings are in its timings.json, never in a hashed artifact.
